## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Paṭhamajananakuhana Sutta* ("Deceit and Flattery (1st)", Iti 35) is a discourse found in the second section of the *Itivuttaka* (It 2.8, PTS It 28). The text teaches that the holy life (*brahmacariya*) is not undertaken for the sake of deceiving or flattering people, but rather for the purpose of restraint and abandoning.
